items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Well, him and Jerry Colonna are very good friends, you know?

ctx.x: Well, that's, if you forget yourself, we'll erase it.

Yeah. Uh, Joe's a crazy guy, buddy. He's a wonderful fiddle player, man. Oh, yeah. And he's good. You put him on a radio with you, man, he make you laugh. You... Yeah. I went, uh, with him, uh, on a radio program one night. I couldn't stop laughing. The guy's so crazy. But you see, Joe Venuti should have been a big star, no kidding. Because he's a terrific fiddle player, boy. And he's funny. Well, him and Jerry Colonna are very good friends, you know? Yeah. And Jerry, I don't know, what happened to Jerry? I don't…
He just dropped out of there. He used to come sit in at the famous door.
